statements.quote: High Performance Computing & Artificial Intelligence (“HPC & AI”) revenue was $1.2 billion, up 37% from the prior-year period in actual dollars and 38% in constant currency (1) , with 4.7% operating profit margin, compared to 3.5% from the prior-year period.
statements.notes: Fourth-quarter fiscal 2023 figure, not the full year. The release does not say this is the quarter, but it compares to the 'prior-year period' and the annual segment table gives a different number. The segment combines HPC and AI, so the figure is not AI-only. The full-year HPC & AI segment revenue of $3,913 million (fiscal 2023) appears only in the segment tables (p04, p05). It is not recorded as a statement because those passages have no sentence to quote.
